Until items 1–6 are established, I would do nothing beyond reading the guide.

The operator should stay on the **dashboard origin**: the forwarded address they used to open the dashboard (e.g. `https://dashboard.agent-browser.localhost`, or whatever proxied/forwarded URL fronts port 4848).

**Why:**

- **The dashboard proxies everything internally.** Session tabs, status, and stream traffic are all routed through the dashboard origin. The dashboard itself reaches the session ports on the operator's behalf, so the browser never needs to talk to them directly.
- **Session ports don't need to be exposed.** Only the dashboard's port is forwarded. An internal session port is likely not reachable from the operator's side of the forward at all, so navigating to it directly would fail or, worse, hit some unrelated service that happens to be on that port locally.
- **The dashboard runs independently of browser sessions.** Sessions come and go, and their ports with them; the dashboard origin is the stable address.

So even if a session tab link appears to reference an internal session port, the operator shouldn't rewrite the URL to that port or set up extra forwards for it. They should use the tabs from within the dashboard at the forwarded origin and let the proxying handle the rest.
